title: ScandiClavia 2
description:
Scandiclavia 2 is a bigger and richer successor to the first Scandiclavia virtual analog nordish organ model.  It yet works as an open mixer format like the previous, but now with 26 Nord organ models to choose from per channel, enhanced sound path and some more new exciting features.

##The Engine

The main sound engine uses the same top quality oscillators as the previous, with the highest possible dynamic range and 26 possible models per oscillator. The models emulate the great Nord organs of all times and can be mixed together and create a vast of sound colors, textures and articulations.  Scandiclavia oscillators also include gleam effect, a user friendly global hipass-lopass filters per oscillator, a rotary speaker emulation, drawbars, hammer generator (click) and a rich effects rack.

##Nuances everywhere

​ScandiClavia got an exclusive hammer manager which manages the percussive effect  of the organ's hammer. You can choose from 7 types from dull to noisy and determine every little nuance of the hammer, including random hit and random intensity.   

##The effects

​Scandiclavia also offers a full section of built in effects (a new cabinet effect with 4 different cabinets emulation, chorus, phaser, wha-wha, reverb, unison and delay).
